name: Сидит на опоре — расслабленно
description: Расслабленная сидячая композиция на подходящей широкой опоре.

layouts.name: У края опоры
required: sitting comfortably near the edge of a broad supporting surface

body.text: body turned slightly three-quarter toward the viewer
torso facing the viewer with a gentle hip shift

legs.text: legs resting naturally to one side

hands.text: one hand resting on the supporting surface
one hand resting lightly on the thigh
both hands resting naturally near the body

head.text: face turned slightly toward the viewer

layouts.name: Свободно сидит по центру
required: sitting comfortably on a broad supporting surface

body.text: body angled gently toward one side

legs.text: one leg folded while the other rests more loosely
both legs bent in an asymmetrical relaxed position

hands.text: one arm supporting the body from behind
one hand placed casually beside the hip

layouts.name: Ракурс между согнутыми ногами
required: lying on the back on a horizontal surface
both legs bent and positioned on opposite sides of the frame
strong perspective foreshortening from a low frontal viewpoint

legs.text: one knee positioned noticeably closer to the camera than the other
both knees raised with mild asymmetry
one leg raised higher while the other remains bent lower

torso.text: upper body resting flat on the supporting surface
upper torso turned slightly to one side
shoulders raised slightly from the supporting surface

hands.text: arms resting naturally beside the torso
one hand resting on the supporting surface near the hip
one arm bent loosely beside the upper body

head.text: face angled generally toward the camera
head turned slightly to one side
chin lowered slightly toward the torso

camera.text: extreme low frontal view from between the bent legs
low diagonal view from near one bent leg
